material_request_rejection_return_serial:

	serial_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (return_id, serial_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(return_id, receipt_line_id) REFERENCES material_request_rejection_returns (id, receipt_line_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,

material_request_rejection_returns:
CREATE TABLE material_request_rejection_returns (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	return_no VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	request_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	revision_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	receipt_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	receipt_line_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	shipment_line_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	outbound_posting_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reservation_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	in_transit_account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	return_source_account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_person_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	actor_role_assignment_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	authorization_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	receipt_request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	trace_request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	evidence_jsonb JSON NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_rejection_returns_binding UNIQUE (id, receipt_line_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_rejection_returns_trace UNIQUE (actor_user_id, trace_request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_returns_quantity_version CHECK (quantity > 0 AND request_version > 0 AND authorization_version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_returns_time CHECK (created_at=occurred_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_returns_accounts CHECK (in_transit_account_id <> return_source_account_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_rejection_returns_reason CHECK (length(trim(reason))>0), 
	UNIQUE (return_no), 
	FOREIGN KEY(request_id) REFERENCES material_requests (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(revision_id) REFERENCES material_request_revisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(receipt_id) REFERENCES receipts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(receipt_line_id) REFERENCES receipt_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(shipment_line_id) REFERENCES shipment_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(outbound_posting_id) REFERENCES outbound_postings (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES stock_reservations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(in_transit_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(return_source_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_person_id) REFERENCES people (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_role_assignment_id) REFERENCES role_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key_hash)
)
